message.content: {"objective": "Verify the reserved broad-search suggestion e1d1 with the reserved 2000-node allowance before committing.", "rationale": "Broad depth-3 search returned e1d1 as the only exact-scored candidate (score 7) while c2c3, e1e2, e1f2 are upper bounds that could be much worse. e1d1 is also the reserved candidate, so it has 2000 nodes available for single-candidate verification at max_depth 4, including the tactical-refutation probe. The king is in check from the a5 queen, so a king move is forced; e1d1 steps off the a5-e1 diagonal and out of the b2-pawn-supported queen's line, whereas e1e2/e1f2 stay nearer the queen's reach and score worse, and c2c3 blocks but leaves the king exposed.", "action": "analyze", "candidate_moves": ["e1d1"], "max_nodes": 2000, "max_depth": 4}
